a:r.a:t: Regulation of Bacterial mRNA Function in Trans by sRNA

p:cNvPr.descr: Part A of a two-part diagram illustrating the regulation of bacterial mRNA function in trans by sRNAs. In part a, there is a green horizontal line labeled 5’ on the left. About a quarter way down on the line, a vertical green line is shown perpendicular to the first segment, and it curves around at the top, creating a circle, and then coming back down to form another perpendicular line to the line, and then extending all the way to the right, where it is labeled 3’ at the end. Where the second perpendicular line meets the horizontal green line is shaded red and labeled, “Ribosome-binding site.” The top part of the structure where the circle is labeled rpoS mRNA. In between the two vertical lines are green bars going down to the horizontal line. Below this structure is an arrow pointing down. To the left of the arrow is a pink, 6-petaled flower that appears to be entering the arrow, and on the right of the arrow is a dark green structure, which has 3’ on the left and 3 vertical loops (the left loop is shortest, followed by a longer middle loop, and a slightly shorter loop to the right), ending with a 5’ in the right. The loops are circular on top, and in between the lines that create the base of the loops, horizontal bars are shown coming down. This is labeled DsrA. Below the arrow, the DsrA structure has connected to the pink flower structure at its 3’ end, and only one loop is seen; the rest of the structure is a line that goes diagonally down and right, then up and left, where the 5’ end is located. Below this line is a lighter green line that begins with 5’ inside the pink flower and curves down, connecting with the ridges of the dark green line in the process, and then forming a wide U shape to the bottom right. From there, it curves slightly up and through the bottom of a muffin-like structure with a yellow cap and orange base. As the light green line moves across the base, it becomes red, and then immediately turns light green again, moving all the way to the right, where it is labeled 3' at the end. The yellow cap of the muffin structure has a gray arrow to its right pointing to the right.
